about: Oracle results of the T3 reference lines (tests/oracle/run_oracle.py, profile spec-v1, one report per dialect), read by benchmarks/t3/tools/acceptance_compare.py --oracle-lines. The reports live in the ignored tests/oracle/results/; the sha256 of each file binds this list to the bytes that were compared, and benchmarks/t3/r6_review.sh copies them, the binding documents and the archive library hash into the evidence bundle. Each line names its library; a report belongs to it when its header names that library_sha256 or, for reports older than that header field, when the archive binding holds. A line without reports keeps the acceptance closed until the owner records an exception (decision_format); the executor never fills owner_decision. The baseline library is not run again for the oracle unless the owner decides so.

decision_format.owner_decision: null, or {"decision": "accept_without_oracle", "control_line": NAME of a line with oracle data, "candidates": [library sha256 of every candidate the exception covers], "by": ..., "date": ..., "note": ...}
decision_format.binding: {"kind": "archive", "library_path": the path every report header names (relative to the repository root), "documents": [{"path", "sha256", "contains": [quoted statements]}]}: the file at library_path must have the line's sha256 and a modification time before the first report; each document its sha256 and every quoted statement
